title: Returning Money to the Card That Paid for a Car Rental
content:
Where a renter has given up a rental booked on the Car Rental Rate Classes, money the renter settled in
advance may be returned to the card that paid for it. The amount returned is raised as one payout against
the money the renter settled in advance, whatever the number of payments that money came in, and once
raised the payout stands on the rental alongside the payment it reverses.

## When the amount is worked out

The amount returned to the card that paid is worked out only after the rental's ledger carries the charge
withheld for the rental being given up.

## A rental given up inside its free-cancellation term

Frozen time in the clause below is the moment at which the desk is handling the matter.

Where a rental was given up while frozen time was not after the moment the supplier confirmed it plus the
free-cancellation term of the rate class booked, its ledger carries no charge for being given up, so nothing
is taken off on that account and the money settled in advance is returned apart from the service element the
desk retains.

## The handling action

The desk performs this for the renter. The tool `post_cancellation_refund_344e0f66` is unlocked and then
called. One call books a single payout line on that rental against the earlier payment line being reversed,
so the amount leaves the rental's net charged total and reaches the renter's original card; the payout line
is recorded as money going out, not as a further charge.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `drive_rental_id` | the internal reference number of the car rental the payout is booked against | an identifier, read from the rental record returned by the car rental lookup |
| `customer_id` | the traveller reference number of the renter the money is returned to | an identifier, read from the traveller profile returned by the profile lookup |
| `source_entry_id` | the reference number of the earlier payment line on that rental that this payout reverses | an identifier, read from the rental ledger lookup |
| `refund_amount_usd` | the amount returned | a US dollar amount with 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent at the moment it is booked, given as a positive figure, recorded as money leaving the rental, and never left empty |

None of the four parameters carries a fixed set of permitted values; each is the value the record or the
figure gives.

## Return

A confirmation sentence naming the reference number of the new payout line, the rental it was booked
against, the amount returned in US dollars to 2 decimal places and the payment line it reverses. A sentence
of that shape means the payout is on the rental's ledger; any other reply means nothing was returned.
